messages:
miriam: Heads-up — Vela Systems sent an invoice that looks like reserved-capacity for EMEA was billed to our NA account by mistake. Total line is $48,200. PDF attached: https://invoices.redwood/VELA-INV-9876.pdf

samir: can you drop the invoice number and affected invoice months? I can pull the ledger and see what actually posted.

miriam: INV-2024-331 and INV-2024-332 (Sep & Oct). Vendor notes 'region: EMEA' on line items but our account id is NA-prod-04.

billing-bot: Invoice extract: INV-2024-331 
  - Reserve pool: 2 x A100 (reserved) 
  - Region: EMEA (vendor) 
  - Amount: $24,100
Invoice extract: INV-2024-332 
  - Reserve pool: 2 x A100 (reserved) 
  - Region: EMEA (vendor) 
  - Amount: $24,100

alex: tagging sales: @alex (account owner) here — we need to avoid leaving the customer on the hook for vendor region tagging. Sales, can we get the vendor to reissue vs. Redwood issuing a goodwill split credit?

alex: my recommendation: amortize as two credits (one per invoice) so invoices reconcile quickly for the customer. Also loop in legal if vendor contract needs amendment.

jordan: FP&A OK with splitting across the two invoices. GL for the credit should be 6402 (Vendor Billing Adjustments). Please confirm and I'll post the journal.

miriam: OK — doing manual credit across INV-2024-331 and INV-2024-332 for $24,100 each. Need final approval from finance lead for >$20k line items.

elena: Approved. This is a billing adjustment (not a price change) so proceed as vendor credit. Note: any single event >$50k requires CFO sign-off; this one is under, so internal approval sufficient. Please cc me on the credit memos.

billing-bot: Action taken: Created credit notes CN-2024-0789 ($24,100) applied to INV-2024-331 and CN-2024-0790 ($24,100) applied to INV-2024-332. Journals queued with GL 6402. Reference: ticket FIN-5642.

miriam: Thanks — looping vendor ops to ask Vela to reissue future invoices with correct region tag so this doesn't repeat. Will update ticket FIN-5642 with vendor confirmation. :thumbsup:
